versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the box-legal-workflows-ma skill for M&A deal room management using Box MCP.
- Enables structured virtual data room creation, role-based access control, and folder hierarchy setup for due diligence.
- Supports permission validation before sharing and guided workflows for both internal and external collaboration.
- Integrates Box AI for cross-document due diligence Q&A and document classification.
- Provides workflow guidance, security best practices, and Box capability references for compliant deal management.
